HF.root.model.rotary_emb: In HF, rotary_emb is a single model-level module (Qwen2RotaryEmbedding) at root.model.rotary_emb that computes position embeddings once in the Qwen2Model.forward() method and then passes them to all decoder layers. In vLLM/SGLang, this functionality is implemented per-layer as root.model.layers.{i}.self_attn.rotary_emb wrapper instances. While architecturally different (single shared instance vs per-layer wrappers), they are functionally equivalent. The HF model-level rotary_emb does not have a direct one-to-one mapping to a single vLLM component, but its functionality is distributed across the per-layer wrappers in vLLM (root.model.layers.{i}.self_attn.rotary_emb), which share the same underlying rotary embedding computation logic.

vLLM.root.model.layers.{i}.self_attn.rotary_e: In vLLM, each attention layer has its own rotary_emb wrapper instance (RotaryEmbeddingWrapper from get_rope()) at root.model.layers.{i}.self_attn.rotary_emb. In HF, there is a single model-level rotary_emb (Qwen2RotaryEmbedding) at root.model.rotary_emb that is shared across all layers. While architecturally different, they are functionally equivalent - the vLLM per-layer wrappers share the same underlying rotary embedding computation. This is an architectural difference in how the rotary embedding is organized, not a difference in the actual computation or weights.
vLLM.root.model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn: This is the RadixAttention module specific to vLLM/SGLang which handles the actual attention computation with KV cache management and backend selection (flashinfer, triton, flash attention 3, etc.). In HF, the attention computation is done inline within the Qwen2Attention.forward() method using attention functions (eager, flash_attention_2, sdpa) selected by the _attn_implementation config, not as a separate module. This is a core implementation difference - vLLM abstracts the attention backend into a separate RadixAttention module while HF keeps it as part of the attention layer logic implemented through function calls. This component is CENTRAL TO THE BUG REPORT as it is where the flashinfer backend produces different results compared to scaled_dot_product_attention. The bug report shows that when comparing attention outputs using _scaled_dot_product_attention vs self.attn (RadixAttention with flashinfer backend), there are differences in max diff, mean diff, and cosine similarity, particularly affecting the last layer accuracy according to the issue title.
vLLM.root.logits_processor: LogitsProcessor is a vLLM-specific module for processing logits (sampling, temperature scaling, top-p, logprob computation, etc.). HF handles this functionality through GenerationMixin and separate utility functions during generation, not as a dedicated model component. This is vLLM-specific infrastructure for serving and generation, not part of the core model weights or forward computation that would affect accuracy differences in the bug report.
vLLM.root.pooler: Pooler is a vLLM-specific module for embedding extraction with LAST or CLS pooling and optional normalization. HF does not have an equivalent component in the model itself - embedding extraction would be done externally by the user. This is vLLM-specific infrastructure for embedding endpoints and not part of the core causal language model computation.
